_note: Scripted conversations. Every line the app speaks is written here, so it is correct Maltese by construction and can be synthesised ahead of time. `accept` lists answers that count as right; matching is phonetic, so spelling and diacritics do not have to be exact. On an open question (`free`), `frames` says where the free bit sits — `Jien …`, `Għandi … sena` — so the fixed Maltese around it is looked for at the start of the answer, at the end, or both, while the name or age in the slot is never graded.

correct.mt: Mela. Nispjega bil-mod, nagħti eżempju, u nirrepeti kemm trid.
correct.en: Of course. I'll explain slowly, give an example, and repeat as much as you like.

close.mt: Kważi. Għid: Nista' nistaqsik xi ħaġa?
close.en: Almost. Say: Can I ask you something?

wrong.en: Say: Can I ask you something?

v4.expect_en: Ask them to practise with you

accept.en: Do you want to practise with me?

accept.mt: Le, grazzi. Nifraħ li tgħallimt xi ħaġa.
accept.en: No thanks. I'm glad I learnt something.

correct.mt: Bi pjaċir. Nifraħ meta xi ħadd jipprova bl-ilsien tagħna.
correct.en: With pleasure. I'm glad when someone tries in our language.

close.en: Almost. Say: Do you want to practise with me?

wrong.en: Say: Do you want to practise with me?

u1.expect_en: Say you'd like to book a table

accept.en: I'd like to book a table.
I'd like to book a table for two.
Do you have a table for this evening?

correct.en: With pleasure. For which day?

close.en: Almost. Say: I'd like to book a table.

wrong.en: Say: I'd like to book a table.

correct.mt: Sew. Nhar il-Ħamis il-post magħluq — imma s-Sibt għandna mejda.
correct.en: Right. On Thursday the place is closed — but on Saturday we have a table.

close.en: Almost. Say: Saturday, please.

u3.say_en: How many of you are there?

correct.en: Perfect. I'll send a confirmation by email.

close.en: Almost. Say: There are ten of us.

wrong.en: Say: There are ten of us.

u4.say_en: How much do you want to spend?

accept.en: About a hundred and fifty euro.

accept.mt: Mhux aktar minn elf ewro għall-festa kollha.
accept.en: No more than a thousand euro for the whole party.

correct.mt: Tajjeb ħafna. Grazzi, u narawkom is-Sibt!
correct.en: Very good. Thank you, and see you on Saturday!

close.mt: Kważi. Għid: Inqas minn mitt ewro.
close.en: Almost. Say: Less than a hundred euro.

wrong.en: Say: Less than a hundred euro.

s1.say_en: Welcome! Are you looking for something?
s1.expect_en: Say what you are looking for

accept.en: I'd like clothes for the winter.
Do you have a new bag?

correct.mt: Mela. Liema kulur trid — l-iswed jew l-isfar?
correct.en: Of course. Which colour do you want — the black or the yellow?

close.mt: Kważi. Għid: Qed infittex żarbun ġdid.
close.en: Almost. Say: I'm looking for new shoes.

wrong.en: Say: I'm looking for new shoes.

correct.mt: Dan hu ġdid, u dak l-ieħor huwa qadim imma nadif.
correct.en: This one is new, and that other one is old but clean.

close.en: Almost. Say: I'd like a green one.

wrong.en: Say: I'd like a green one.

s3.say_en: Do you want a long one or a short one?
s3.expect_en: Choose, and ask about the price

accept.mt: Qasir, jekk jogħġbok. Kemm hu l-prezz?
accept.en: Short, please. How much is it?
Long. Is there a sale today?

accept.mt: Ma jogħġobnix dan. Għandkom xi ħaġa oħra?
accept.en: I don't like this one. Do you have anything else?

correct.mt: Illum hemm bejgħ kbir — kollox bi prezz inqas. Prego!
correct.en: Today there's a big sale — everything at a lower price. You're welcome!

close.mt: Kważi. Għid: Twil. Hemm bejgħ illum?
close.en: Almost. Say: Long. Is there a sale today?

wrong.en: Say: Long. Is there a sale today?

r1.say_en: Everything all right? You've been out here a while.

accept.en: I can't get in — I forgot the key.

correct.mt: Ma jimpurtax. Oqgħod bilqiegħda hawn — jien għandi waħda oħra.
correct.en: Never mind. Have a seat here — I have another one.

close.en: Almost. Say: I forgot the key.

r2.say_en: Have a seat. Do you want anything?

correct.mt: Le le, nġib jien. Trid ilma kiesaħ jew te sħun?
correct.en: No no, I'll bring it. Do you want cold water or hot tea?

close.en: Almost. Say: I'm thirsty.

accept.en: I remember now — the key is in the bag!

correct.mt: Ħa nixgħel id-dawl u naraw. Tassew, hemm qiegħda!
correct.en: Let me put the light on and we'll see. Really, there it is!

close.en: Almost. Say: I feel better, thanks.

q1.say_en: What do you do in your free time?

accept.en: I sing and listen to music.

correct.en: Nice! Do you do that every day?

close.en: Almost. Say: I play football.

q2.say_en: Do you do that every day?

correct.mt: Jien niġri kull għodwa qabel ix-xogħol.
correct.en: I run every morning before work.

close.en: Almost. Say: Every morning.

accept.en: I drive from one country to another.

correct.mt: Jien inħobb il-logħba tal-karti mal-ħbieb aktar mill-ivvjaġġar.
correct.en: I like a game of cards with friends more than travelling.

close.en: Almost. Say: Yes, I travel a lot.

wrong.en: Say: Yes, I travel a lot.

p1.say_en: Do you live with your family?

accept.en: I live with my grandmother and grandfather.
I live with my mother and father.

correct.en: Nice. Are you married?

close.mt: Kważi. Għid: Ngħix man-nanna u man-nannu.
close.en: Almost. Say: I live with my grandmother and grandfather.

wrong.en: Say: I live with my grandmother and grandfather.

accept.en: Yes, and I have two children.

correct.en: Well done! I'm glad for you.

close.mt: Kważi. Għid: Iva, u għandi żewġt itfal.
close.en: Almost. Say: Yes, and I have two children.

wrong.mt: Għid: Iva, u għandi żewġt itfal.
wrong.en: Say: Yes, and I have two children.

accept.mt: In-nies ta' dik l-età jafu ħafna.
accept.en: People of that age know a lot.

correct.mt: Iva, u għadu jaħdem bħal żagħżugħ. Sellili għal ommok!
correct.en: Yes, and he still works like a young man. Say hi to your mother!

close.mt: Kważi. Għid: Huwa xiħ imma qawwi!
close.en: Almost. Say: He's old but strong!

o1.say_en: What do you do for work?

accept.en: I work as an IT worker.

correct.en: Interesting. Is your work difficult?

close.mt: Kważi. Għid: Naħdem bħala ħaddiem tal-IT.
close.en: Almost. Say: I work as an IT worker.

wrong.en: Say: I work as an IT worker.

accept.mt: Xi kultant, imma nħobb ix-xogħol tiegħi.
accept.en: Sometimes, but I love my job.

correct.en: Well done. What time do you leave home in the morning?

close.mt: Kważi. Għid: Le, huwa faċli għalija.
close.en: Almost. Say: No, it's easy for me.

wrong.en: Say: No, it's easy for me.

o3.say_en: What time do you leave home?
o3.expect_en: Say when you leave and arrive

accept.en: I leave at seven and arrive at eight.
I drive for half an hour.

correct.en: Early! I start work in the afternoon.

close.en: Almost. Say: I leave very early.

n1.say_en: This feast is lovely. What do you think?

accept.en: I don't agree — there are too many people.

correct.en: Interesting. Everyone has their own opinion.

close.mt: Kważi. Għid: Ma naqbilx — hemm wisq nies.
close.en: Almost. Say: I don't agree — there are too many people.

wrong.mt: Għid: Ma naqbilx — hemm wisq nies.
wrong.en: Say: I don't agree — there are too many people.

n2.say_mt: U l-ikel? Nixtieq nisma' l-fehma tiegħek.
n2.say_en: And the food? I'd like to hear your opinion.
n2.expect_en: Say what you think of the food

accept.mt: Nemmen li l-ikel Malti huwa l-aħjar.
accept.en: I believe Maltese food is the best.

accept.mt: Huwa tajjeb, imma jiswa aktar mis-soltu.
accept.en: It's good, but it costs more than usual.

correct.mt: Nwieġeb jien: jien stess ma nafx x'nagħżel.
correct.en: I'll answer myself: I don't know what to choose either.

close.mt: Kważi. Għid: Nemmen li l-ikel Malti huwa l-aħjar.
close.en: Almost. Say: I believe Maltese food is the best.

wrong.mt: Għid: Nemmen li l-ikel Malti huwa l-aħjar.
wrong.en: Say: I believe Maltese food is the best.

n3.say_mt: Ħafna nies jaħsbu li l-Malti se jintilef. X'taħseb int?
n3.say_en: Many people think Maltese will be lost. What do you think?

accept.en: I believe it won't be lost.
I look at the children and I'm glad.

correct.mt: Jien nirringrazzja lil kull min jitgħallem l-ilsien tagħna.
correct.en: I thank everyone who learns our language.

close.mt: Kważi. Għid: Nemmen li mhux se jintilef.
close.en: Almost. Say: I believe it won't be lost.

wrong.mt: Għid: Nemmen li mhux se jintilef.
wrong.en: Say: I believe it won't be lost.

m1.say_en: The weather is lovely today. What do you see outside?

accept.mt: Hemm ftit sħab u ftit riħ.
accept.en: There are a few clouds and a bit of wind.
The day is clear and hot.

correct.en: Perfect. Let's go to the sea!

close.en: Almost. Say: The sun is shining.

m2.expect_en: Agree, and say what you'll bring

accept.en: I'll bring my bag and my shoes.

correct.en: Good. The bus leaves at ten.

close.en: Almost. Say: Yes, let's go!

m3.say_en: How long will we be there?

accept.mt: Nkun lura sal-lejl — nixtieq nara x-xemx nieżla.
accept.en: I'll be back by night — I'd like to see the sun go down.

correct.mt: Mela ejja. Jum bħal dan ma jiġix kuljum!
correct.en: Let's go then. A day like this doesn't come every day!

close.en: Almost. Say: Just a few hours.
